title: Add responsive yearly progress bar chart above Monthly Volume Summary

requirements.text: Add a new "Yearly Progress" chart section above the existing "Monthly Volume Summary" in the Becoming view.

quotes: Add a yearly progress chart section above the Monthly Volume Summary.
Yes just current year as per the current layout of the app

acceptanceCriteria: In the Becoming view, a new section appears above the Monthly Volume Summary when habits are available (same general visibility conditions as the summary).
The existing Monthly Volume Summary remains present and unchanged below the new chart section.

requirements.text: Render the yearly progress chart as a responsive grouped bar chart with Jan–Dec on the x-axis and an automatically scaled y-axis based on the computed monthly totals.

quotes: The chart should be a bar graph showing data for each month from January to December.
Make the chart responsive... Ensure the x-axis displays the months and the y-axis scales automatically based on the monthly totals.

acceptanceCriteria: The x-axis displays the 12 months from January through December (at least using short labels like Jan, Feb, etc.).
The chart rescales its y-axis automatically when underlying monthly totals change (no hard-coded max).
The chart layout remains usable on mobile and desktop (does not overflow the page width; labels remain legible).

requirements.text: Compute chart data from the existing saved daily habit data by aggregating all habits into monthly totals for (a) Total Reps and (b) Total Time converted to hours for each month (Jan–Dec).

quotes: It should track two metrics: 'Total Reps' and 'Total Time' (converted to hours).
The data is currently being recorded and saved. I track it each day so once completed it will be included

acceptanceCriteria: For each month index 0–11, the chart shows a Total Reps value equal to the sum of all habits' monthly reps totals for that month.
For each month index 0–11, the chart shows a Total Time value equal to the sum of all habits' monthly time totals for that month, converted from seconds to hours (hours may be fractional).
The chart updates automatically when the habits query data changes (e.g., after the user records additional daily completions).

requirements.text: Style the chart section with a clean modern aesthetic consistent with the current UI and using blue and gray tones, and include a clear legend identifying "Total Reps" and "Total Time (hours)".

quotes: use a clean modern aesthetic with blue and gray tones to match the current UI, and include a legend.

acceptanceCriteria: The chart section uses existing design tokens/components (e.g., glass-surface card styling) and visually matches the rest of the Becoming UI.
A legend is visible and clearly maps each metric to its bar color: Total Reps and Total Time (hours).
User-facing text in the chart section is in English.

requirements.text: Limit the yearly progress chart to the current calendar year only (no year switching UI).

quotes: Should the chart display only the current calendar year...
Yes just current year as per the current layout of the app

acceptanceCriteria: The chart displays a single year view for the current calendar year, with no controls for selecting other years.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/immutablePaths (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).

Keep backend architecture as a single Motoko actor; only introduce backend changes if strictly required (this request should be fulfilled using existing saved daily data already available to the frontend).
nonGoals: Adding a year picker or viewing historical years beyond the current year.
Adding new backend data models or migrations solely to support the chart, unless aggregation cannot be computed from existing returned habit data.
Adding tooltips, filtering, exports, or drill-down interactions beyond the requested legend and axes.
